D/ [?-CON]STAN S PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Trier mint, RIC vol. 8 no. 204, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [?-CON]STAN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths, a fir tree between Victories. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: TR[?].…
